stage: TZ v1.1 section 6.3 - independent SPICE acceptance

inputs.note: spec.json was re-read from disk after the final renumbering; LDK320AM15R is absent and no U0011 appears. The independent suite reads the variant list directly from this file.
datasheets: LDK220 ST DS10219 Rev 7 (11/2021), Tables 6/7, Figs 14/23
LDK320 ST DS11321 Rev 13 (06/2025), Tables 6/7, Figs 13/22

ngspice.engine: ngspice-44 from KiCad 9.0 ngspice.dll (CDLL bridge, one child process per deck)
coverage: Nominal VOUT at 1 mA with VIN = max(VNOM+1, 2.5) V; ADJ uses R1=18k/R2=10k and target VREF*(1+R1/R2) = 2.8*VREF
VOUT at 200 mA plus 1 mA-to-200 mA load slope against datasheet %%/mA and mV limits
Dropout at 100 and 200 mA by the datasheet definition (VIN-VOUT at VOUT = VNOM-100 mV): all 12 fixed 3.3/5.0 V catalogue positions, the only VOUT values with a published dropout condition
IQ at no load, 200 mA and off mode (EN=0); EN logic at 0.4/1.2 V; 18 ohm discharge on LDK220 SOT23-5L and its absence on LDK320
ISC ~400 mA (LDK220); ~330 mA at low drop and ~200 mA at VIN=16 V (LDK320 SOA); startup t90 with COUT=1 uF
VEN threshold sweep and structural/portability checks of the model file
ngspice.criteria_basis: Datasheet min/max limits for guaranteed parameters; documented engineering windows around datasheet typicals for dropout, ISC, Rdis, Ton and IQ. No criterion was fitted to author-reported values. Model has no tolerance or temperature modelling, so only TJ = 25 C typical behaviour is asserted.

findings.summary: In ngspice .op, LDK320 fixed subcircuits with an ideal 100 mA current-sink load fall back to the transient operating point and return a non-physical VOUT. Resistive loads converge; the acceptance suite uses resistive loads everywhere.

ngspice.fallback_note: 5 acceptance decks (IQ at no load) plus the dedicated convergence probe used ngspice's transient OP fallback; their recorded values are inside the acceptance windows and are not hidden. Native Altium convergence was checked separately by the Sifter tests below.

spice_sifter.tool_note: The dbur_test.py name referenced in the task no longer exists on disk; spice_sifter.py is the current standalone SPICE runner of the same Spice Tester project.
spice_sifter.mode: standalone SPICE (test JSON with spice deck + models include), Altium Designer 24.4.1.13
spice_sifter.objective: Verify native MixedSim acceptance of PARAMS: VNOM=/VREF= substituted inside VALUE={...} in all seven subcircuits

scope_notes: No author diagnostics (_dev_sanity.py / _dev_sanity.json) were read or used as evidence.
No files in MY_LIB/ or spice/work/ were modified; only spice/tests/, spice/results/ and this validation.json were written.
Native Altium symbol/footprint display, DbLib binding and Sim Port Map integration are outside this SPICE test.
The model has no temperature dependence, tolerance spread, PSRR, noise, thermal shutdown or loop dynamics; those properties were not asserted.
